Senior Backend Engineer
Aurora Labs — Berlin (hybrid)

Aurora Labs builds the data plane that powers fraud detection for European fintechs. We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own the ingestion pipeline that processes 4B events per day and to coach two mid-level engineers as the team grows.

What you'll do
• Design and ship services in Go that move events from Kafka into ClickHouse with sub-second tail latency
• Run incident response on a weekly on-call rotation with two other engineers
• Review code from teammates daily and raise the team's bar for testing and observability
• Partner with the data science team on the schema of new event types and the back-pressure model

What we're looking for
• 5+ years building production backend services, ideally in Go, Python, or a similar systems language
• Deep familiarity with PostgreSQL or another relational database at scale (sharding, replication, query tuning)
• Hands-on experience operating services on Kubernetes in a public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
• Comfort with distributed systems trade-offs: CAP, idempotency, exactly-once semantics
• Track record of mentoring less senior engineers

Nice to have
• Experience with stream processing (Kafka Streams, Flink, or similar)
• Background in fraud, AML, or another high-stakes domain
• Familiarity with Docker-based local development

We offer a remote-first culture, a real on-call comp budget, and 30 days of paid leave.
